summary: Let tests that mostly wait share the test run's slots, so their waits overlap instead of holding one CPU-sized slot each

replay.detail: Test and CI runner configuration only; no claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: No product behavior, protocol, command or stored state changes; the test selection, retries and timeouts are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
